text:
Lena Patel: Hey infra — onboarding for tenant 'acme-ai' needs AZ GPU quota + capacity reservation. I started a quota request but want to track everything here. Subscription: sub-9f3b-4a7d (partial). Region: westeurope primary, eastus2 fallback.
Marc O'Connor: Which SKUs and how many nodes?
Lena Patel: ND A100 v4 (Standard_ND96asr_v4) x6 in westeurope. NCv3 (Standard_NC6s_v3) x4 in eastus2 for legacy jobs. Also need public IP limit and NIC limits increased.
Jason Wu: For NDv4 Azure needs region+sku quotas. I filed SR 2302123456 and linked the subscription. Support asked for workload description and monthly commit numbers. Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/Case/2302123456 (internal).
Priya Desai: Cost note — reserving 6 NDv4s is pricey. Recommend 4 reserved + 2 on-demand burst. Can finance approve a partial reserved commit? Tag all resources with 'acme-project' for chargeback.
Marc O'Connor: Also include VNet / subnet IP usage and NSG rule counts. We hit NIC limits during the last rollout. Put the quota asks in the ticket body: vCPUs +512, Public IPs +50, Network interfaces +100.
azure-support-bot: Azure support updated SR 2302123456: Request received and forwarded to capacity team. Estimated review 48-72h. Please provide workload forecast and any peak hour RPS.
Lena Patel: Adding details to SR: workload = inference-serving for customer release, avg sustained tokens ~1.2B/month, peak QPS ~1200, expected start date 2026-04-15. Contact: infra@acme.com.
Jason Wu: I recommended capacity reservation rather than just quota increase since they need predictable throughput and lower preemption risk. I added suggested reservation: 4x ND96asr_v4 reserved + 2x on-demand. Ticket note: reserved capacity requested for 4 nodes for 12 months.
Priya Desai: Finance: tentative approval needed before we commit. Estimated monthly delta for 4 reserved NDv4s ~ $68k. Can we do a staged commit (3 months trial)?
Marc O'Connor: I created a tracker row in the GPU quota spreadsheet: https://drive.reddit/drive/fake-link (internal). Added SR#, subscription, tenant, region, SKUs, requested increments, contact, and cost estimate.
Lena Patel: Also we need ICE for networking: request to increase Load Balancer backend pool limits and frontend port range. These hit our e2e tests.
Jason Wu: Terraform snippet for tagging + quota metadata I pushed to infra repo. Use this when provisioning: 
```hcl
resource "azurerm_virtual_machine" "acme_infer" {
  name                = "acme-infer-01"
  location            = "westeurope"
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.acme.name
  # SKU set to ND96asr_v4 via image reference or vm_size
  vm_size             = "Standard_ND96asr_v4"
  tags = {
    project = "acme-project"
    owner   = "acme-infra"
  }
}
```
Marc O'Connor: Action items: 1) Jason to follow SR and push reservation justification (ETA: today). 2) Priya to confirm finance for partial commit (ETA: tomorrow EOD). 3) Lena to add detailed network limits and attach test failures (ETA: today). 4) I'll update quota tracker and monitor SR (owner: Marc).
azure-support-bot: SR 2302123456 status change: Waiting on capacity team review. Next update expected within 2 business days.
Lena Patel: Noted. Also created a fallback plan: if NDv4 capacity delayed, we can spin 8x NCv3 in eastus2 for short term, but perf will be lower and cost higher. Documented migration steps in the runbook.
Priya Desai: Reminder to add billing tags and set up alerting on subscription quotas so we don't get surprised. I can add policy to auto-tag on VM create.
Jason Wu: Logged the subscription ID and tenant admin email in the SR. Leaving a note to include private link endpoints and NSG exceptions for the acme VNET.
Marc O'Connor: Closing loop — I'll post updates here when SR moves. If support asks for firm commit numbers, we'll use 4 reserved + 2 burst as the recommended plan unless finance says otherwise. :thumbsup:
